listing_id.note: Foreign key into data/annotation_ready/listings.csv. Pre-filled -- never edit this column.

confidence.note: Must follow from the signal tier and corroboration cited in the evidence fields, not be a separate free judgment. Precise per-value anchors: LABEL_SCHEMA.json's confidence_scale and DECISION_RULES.md's confidence table.

reason.note: One-line summary of the overall call. See annotation/guidelines/EVIDENCE_RULES.md.

insufficient_evidence_reason.note: Required in practice whenever label=insufficient_evidence -- see EVIDENCE_RULES.md.

_paths_note: All four *_doc paths above are relative to this file's own directory (annotation/guidelines/) -- they resolve to the canonical copies, not the top-level pointer files.
